title: Cloud Architect
description: We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Architect to lead large-scale migrations of legacy and third-party applications into modern cloud and container platforms. You will shape target-state architecture, guide delivery teams, and align stakeholders on the best path forward. Responsibilities Lead application and infrastructure discovery to assess legacy and third-party workloads Define target-state systems architecture across AWS, Kubernetes, and private cloud options Facilitate workshops with clients and architecture stakeholders to gather requirements Create migration plans and test plans aligned with business needs and risk constraints Decide platform approach and landing zone integration based on workload requirements Oversee engineering execution and unblock teams during migration delivery Provide hands-on expertise for DevOps and cloud tasks when needed Guide containerization strategy and ensure workloads are packaged for modern platforms Design CI/CD pipeline approach to support repeatable and controlled releases Coordinate with security and solution architecture to ensure compliant designs Requirements 7+ years cloud and systems development experience with large-scale migration programs 5+ years infrastructure as code experience with Terraform in production environments 5+ years configuration management and automation experience with Ansible 5+ years containerization experience and platform selection for Kubernetes or EKS Strong technical leadership skills to guide architects and engineering teams Strong client communication skills to facilitate workshops and align on approach Advanced English skills (C1, Advanced) Nice to have Python proficiency We offer International projects with top brands Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers Healthcare benefits Employee financial programs Paid time off and sick leave Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses Global career opportunities Volunteer and community involvement opportunities EPAM Employee Groups Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn EPAM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
